reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about the formation of nanoscale heterogeneities under loading and their effect on dislocation mobility, cohesion, and toughness, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises.
premises: Thermal/mechanical loading induces nanoscale grain-boundary clustering or short-range ordering in initially single-phase HEAs
Such nanoscale heterogeneities lower local dislocation mobility
Such nanoscale heterogeneities lower local cohesion
Reduced dislocation mobility and cohesion reduce overall toughness and promote brittle behavior
